correctness.rationale: The negative doubling two affine branches have equal-length inverse cylinders, hence Lebesgue branch codes are IID fair bits. The left hole (1/4,1/2) is forbidden 00; the right dyadic cylinder is B_l=11 0 1 0... of length l=2k+1 or 2k+2. Since B_l contains no 00, first forbidden start is determined by first completion of either unequal-length word. Proper suffix-prefix overlaps yield two renewal equations, with an odd B-to-00 one-symbol overlap and an even B-to-B one-symbol overlap; elimination gives both displayed rational PGFs with denominator 1-t-t²+t^(2k+1). Differentiation at z=1 gives means (4^(k+1)-1-6k)/(4^k+2) and (4^(k+1)-1-3k)/(4^k+2). Because B_(2k+2)=B_(2k+1)1 and avoiding 00 forces a 1 after B_(2k+1), the infinite survivor languages agree; the Perron root comes from 1-sum_{j=0}^{k-1} t^(2j+1). Independent exhaustive enumeration of 2^(h+l+1) fair-bit words for k=1,2,3, both hole parities and h=0..5 reproduced the coefficients of each rational PGF exactly, using Fraction arithmetic. These finite cases corroborate; renewal and symbolic inclusion prove every k and horizon.
